[package]
edition = "2021"
name = "adler2"
version = "2.0.1"
authors = [
    "Jonas Schievink <jonasschievink@gmail.com>",
    "oyvindln <oyvindln@users.noreply.github.com>",
]
build = false
exclude = [".*"]
autolib = false
autobins = false
autoexamples = false
autotests = false
autobenches = false
description = "A simple clean-room implementation of the Adler-32 checksum"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/adler2/"
readme = "README.md"
keywords = [
    "checksum",
    "integrity",
    "hash",
    "adler32",
    "zlib",
]
categories = ["algorithms"]
license = "0BSD OR MIT OR Apache-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/oyvindln/adler2"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
rustdoc-args = ["--cfg=docsrs"]

[package.metadata.release]
no-dev-version = true
pre-release-commit-message = "Release {{version}}"
tag-message = "{{version}}"

[[package.metadata.release.pre-release-replacements]]
file = "CHANGELOG.md"
replace = """
## Unreleased

No changes.

## [{{version}} - {{date}}](https://github.com/jonas-schievink/adler/releases/tag/v{{version}})
"""
search = """
## Unreleased
"""

[[package.metadata.release.pre-release-replacements]]
file = "README.md"
replace = 'adler = "{{version}}"'
search = 'adler = "[a-z0-9\\.-]+"'

[[package.metadata.release.pre-release-replacements]]
file = "src/lib.rs"
replace = "https://docs.rs/adler/{{version}}"
search = 'https://docs.rs/adler/[a-z0-9\.-]+'

[features]
default = ["std"]
rustc-dep-of-std = ["core"]
std = []

[lib]
name = "adler2"
path = "src/lib.rs"

[[bench]]
name = "bench"
path = "benches/bench.rs"
harness = false

[dependencies.core]
version = "1.0.0"
optional = true
package = "rustc-std-workspace-core"

[dev-dependencies]

bounded_contract.target: Exact core Default implementation for original concrete Copy Adler32; new calls Self::default once and transports whole returned state.
bounded_contract.value: Both functions return a=1,b=0, hence existing checksum() returns1. No input, external read/write, allocation, panic or divergence.
bounded_contract.ownership: Complete named u16 fields and actual positive Copy/source closure; no drop or invented purity permission for unrelated methods.

independent_expectations: new and exact Default both produce identity checksum1 and exact two fields a1/b0
source-local selected Default implementation must equal original owning impl/member, no substitutions
constructor result flows once into new result and existing getter consumer
default std and no-default alias core as std preserve values; native oracle no cross-target runtime claim
negative_expectations: wrong selected trait/implementation/member, wrong source owner or substituted Self must reject
default method body a2/b3 must not inherit original value summary
inherent default can shadow trait syntax; spelling Self::default alone is insufficient
omitted/swapped/lost field, absent/forged Copy proof and hidden Drop/macro closure must reject
lost callee call/return or fabricated pure summary, profile downgrade and altered source/build context must reject

prior_support.explicit_prior_exclusion: new/default require trait-method definition/call support; this selection adds that connected chain, not another getter.

readiness_unknowns: Actual selected core Default/current driver observation and local owning member capture
Original concrete trait member source membership and namespace/import closure
No-argument Copy-product helper result export and caller linking
Whole constructor-to-getter strict admission/composition and all selected pair enumeration

oracle_scope.public: Unchanged original library public new/default plus already-supported checksum consumer; numeric identity specified independently.
oracle_scope.diagnostic: Original declaration, new function and complete Default impl copied exactly; added sibling witness functions return exact a/b fields. Neighbor methods not compiled, so this is not original owning-context acceptance.
oracle_scope.remaining: Full-context captures, independent strict verification/admission/matching, resealed source/implementation corruptions and gains/losses on unchanged selections remain required.
